# Test fixtures

| File | Nature |
|---|---|
| `open_meteo_bengaluru.json` | **Real** Open-Meteo response (V2 request shape), recorded 27 Sep 2026 10:30 IST via the user's browser |
| `open_meteo_v3_*.json` | **Real** Open-Meteo responses (V3 request shape: current + 7 past days + 3-day forecast), recorded 27 Sep 2026 ~11:15 IST via the user's browser for the three demo warehouse coordinates |
| `ogd_mandi_synthetic.json` | **Synthetic** response shaped like the data.gov.in API. Invented prices for parser/validation tests only; never loaded into the app |
